Sreeram Anantharaman

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Variational Bayes
parts:
Hi Sreeram,
As of now it doesn't, and I'm not aware of a package doing that.
If you would want to build it through nimbleFunctions using automatic differentiation, we'd be happy to try to support you in that.
Best wishes,
Perry
